QUOTE: "`search_emptiness` calls `q.unsearched_corpora`... If any of the remaining kinds (typedefs, macros, variables, and so on) hold a row matching the query, the reply says 'NOT DEFINITIVE'" and the table row: "'definitive' (single token, no unread hits, file docs present)".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the strong "definitive" wording is granted only after a per-query check of which corpora `search` did not read, and is downgraded when unread kinds hold matching rows. It is not given for every empty result.
